outcomes.archive-byte-identical: Complete compressed archive bytes are identical.
outcomes.payload-identical: Extracted path/type/link/mode/content graph is identical and all semantically relevant timestamp relations match; container-only differences may remain.
outcomes.equivalent-under-declared-consumer-contr: Identity/platform gates pass; every payload difference has an explicit non-semantic rule; all proof-critical exact-byte gates pass; every required consumer probe passes.
outcomes.not-established: At least one unexplained, proof-critical, platform-changing, or required-but-unprobed difference remains.

workflow: Declare consumer contract and exact baseline before examining differences.
Compare complete compressed bytes and cryptographic digests.
If needed, compare decompressed tar bytes and normalized tar-entry metadata.
Extract independently into fresh roots and inventory the typed filesystem graphs.
Classify every difference by artifact class.
Recompute proof-critical cryptographic identities; do not trust Lake .hash sidecars as integrity evidence.
Parse known Lake trace schemas and compare fields according to consumer role.
Record Lake hash-current versus old-mode mtime-current reuse and relevant strict timestamp ordering.
Run contract-specific consumer probes only after static differences are classified.
Assign the weakest justified outcome and preserve a difference ledger.

artifact_classes.automatic_acceptance: May differ if decompressed tar bytes are identical and compression bytes are outside the declared consumer contract.
artifact_classes.failure_boundary: A decompressed tar mismatch requires deeper comparison.

artifact_classes.automatic_acceptance: Only fields proven irrelevant to the actual extraction/consumer path may differ.
Exact bytes by default; schema-aware normalization only with pinned consumer semantics.
compare: normalized parsed form if explicitly justified

artifact_classes.automatic_acceptance: Exact bytes on the same platform.
artifact_classes.failure_boundary: Different bytes require a separate upgrade/migration validation and are not accepted by the strict same-contract procedure.

artifact_classes.automatic_acceptance: Exact bytes for the coherent artifact family, with matching Lean and Lake identity.
artifact_classes.failure_boundary: Differing proof-critical module bytes are not accepted by smoke testing alone.

compare: rehash behavior when execution is available
artifact_classes.failure_boundary: Equal .hash sidecars do not prove equal or authentic artifact bytes.

artifact_classes.permitted_difference: Inputs captions may differ when freshness is unchanged and provenance text is outside the contract; logs may differ only if replayed diagnostics are outside the contract.
artifact_classes.failure_boundary: Unknown or operational field differences remain not-established.
Differing identity/options are operational unless separately proved irrelevant.

artifact_classes.automatic_acceptance: Path/type/symlink/hardlink/execute/write semantics must match the declared consumer contract.
artifact_classes.failure_boundary: Current Anneal's recursive read-only payload makes write-bit differences material by default.

artifact_classes.automatic_acceptance: Exact equality not required generally; compare consumer-relevant ordering predicates.
compare: strict input < output relation for old-mode fallback
artifact_classes.failure_boundary: If old-mode reuse is part of the contract, collapsing the strict ordering is material.
Cross-platform equivalence requires independent artifact-specific evidence.

consumer_probe_requirements: Use separate fresh installation/extraction roots; never reuse one Exocrate managed namespace to compare two local archives.
Make producer/staging roots unavailable before relocation-sensitive probes.
Use the same controlled environment and source input.
Record reuse versus rebuild and hash-current versus mtime-current status for prepared Lake outputs.
Compare contract-visible success/failure, proof-critical generated outputs, and diagnostics.
If process-wide offline operation is claimed, enforce or observe network access rather than inferring absence from path dependencies.
fail_closed_rules: Proof-critical binary/source/config/module bytes differ => not-established under strict same-contract comparison.
Platform identity differs => not-established under default procedure.
Required consumer probe missing or fails => not-established.
Similarity of version strings, directory layout, or smoke-test behavior cannot override a stronger failed gate.
